meta.title: RepoChan · Your repo, but make it a girl
meta.description: Turn any git repository into a mascot persona, foundation sheet, stickers, posters, and a landing page — driven by your coding agent.

lobby.manifesto: RepoChan turns a git repository into a complete brand kit: persona, foundation sheet, stickers, posters, landing pages — orchestrated by your coding agent. Hard rules live in code; creative judgment lives in skills. No embedded runtime.

portrait.title: Opening Portrait · RepoChan
portrait.note: Silver hair with pink-and-mint streaks, heterochromia. The character appears only here in the lobby; the rest of the museum belongs to the work.

lobby.noteBody: The permanent galleries are real RepoChan pipeline deliverables for this project. The case wing shows unofficial mascot demos run on public repos — not affiliated with upstream.

galleryA.title: Foundation
galleryA.intro: The visual anchor for every downstream asset. Character, expressions, palette and key motifs agree on a single sheet first — only then are they allowed into production.

exhibit.title: Foundation Sheet
exhibit.note: Every downstream order in this museum cites this sheet as its consistency baseline — stickers, posters, cutouts all shipped with its signature.

galleryB.title: Character Studies
galleryB.intro: From foundation sheet to production: complete-in-frame, full-margin general-purpose cutouts, plus expression studies extracted from the sticker master grids.

main.title: Cutout B · Wave
main.note: The discipline of a general-purpose cutout: whole body in frame, margins on all four sides, placeable in any composition.

galleryC.title: Editions
galleryC.intro: Eighteen small works sliced from two 3×3 master grids: one set of mood stickers, one set of web states. Same character, same foundation sheet — holding up eighteen times over.

galleryD.title: Posters & Patterns
galleryD.intro: The print room. A risograph poster of the studio scene, a Memphis poster, and a seamless pattern.

main.title: Sugar Riff Studio
main.note: Risograph texture: halftone dots, slight misregistration, paper grain. The character, in her own studio.

notes.title: Pipeline Notes
notes.intro: Behind every exhibit runs the same six-step pipeline. The commands are the wall text.

steps.title: Analyze the repo
steps.desc: README, code structure and commit history, all turned into design evidence.

steps.title: Interview
steps.desc: Structured questions that draw out the project's tone, audience and weight.

steps.title: Create the persona
steps.desc: Three collaborating agents sculpt a living mascot.

steps.title: Open asset orders
steps.desc: The art director opens every Asset Order at once, foundation sheet first.

steps.title: Paint
steps.desc: Sheets, stickers and posters generated per order; repaint if not satisfied — old versions become history.

steps.title: Assemble the site
steps.desc: Assets mounted into a landing page, doors open — like the museum you are standing in.

shop.title: Take the Pipeline Home
shop.intro: Node.js ≥ 20 · a coding agent you already use · optional image endpoint.

cards.title: Install CLI + skills
cards.desc: One command: install the CLI and wire skills into your agent.

cards.title: Start creating
cards.desc: Open your agent in a project and run /repochan (or plain language).

cards.title: Look up a work
cards.desc: Every exhibit is traceable — start from the collection number on its label.

showcase.title: Repo girls in the wild
showcase.intro: Unofficial mascot demos on well-known public repos. Every face came from real analysis → persona → order → image — open a case for the full persona dossier.
showcase.unofficial: Unofficial demos. Not affiliated with Redis, Caddy, ripgrep, or any upstream project — pipeline demonstration only.
